ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with approximately 7-10% high-intensity (white) pixels distributed as localized markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-toned background across both lobes. No contiguous white pigmentation patches; surface is punctuated by scattered high-contrast white linear filaments and circular dots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Jagged trailing boundary featuring frequent micro-serrations and several larger notches, particularly on the inner half of the left lobe's edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping convex curve originating from the median notch and terminating at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible circular high-contrast clusters; one distinct grouping in the upper-central right lobe and several smaller clusters on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, unaligned linear scratches; high density of vertical rake marks on the lower-medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, irregular clusters of high-intensity textured calcified matter (barnacles) located at the extreme tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white ring-shaped pixel formation (circular scar) located in the upper quadrant of the right lobe.
